# Rido

> Rido is a shared e-scooter and e-bike micro-mobility service launching on the Costa del Sol, Spain. Zero-emission shared vehicles available via a mobile app. Operated by Go2 Place S.L.

## About
Rido is a shared micro-mobility company providing e-scooters and e-bikes for rent by the minute via a mobile app. The service is launching in 5 cities on the Costa del Sol; the launch cities will be announced soon. The company is committed to zero-emission transport, swappable batteries, and carbon-neutral operations.

## How It Works
1. Join the waitlist at https://www.rido.bike#download
2. Download the Rido app (launching soon on iOS and Android)
3. Find a Rido vehicle near you on the in-app map
4. Scan the QR code on the handlebar to unlock
5. Ride following traffic rules and bike lanes
6. Park in a designated area shown in the app
7. End the ride and pay only for what you used

## Pricing
Fares will be announced at launch. Until then, the promise is the same as on the site: you see the price before every ride. No hidden fees, no minimum top-up, free refund of unused balance.

Plan names only — amounts are not public yet:
- **Pay as you go**: No commitment. Ride when you need it.
- **Rido Pass**: Frequent-rider membership. Exact pricing announced at launch.
- **Day Pass**: Aimed at visitors who want a full day. Exact pricing announced at launch.

## Vehicles
- **Rido Scooter** (e-scooter): 45 km range, 25 km/h top speed, 120 kg weight limit, swappable battery, dual brakes, turn signals, GPS tracking, beginner mode.
- **Rido Bike** (e-bike): 60 km range, 25 km/h pedal assist, 130 kg weight limit, swappable battery, electric pedal assist, front cargo basket, step-through frame.

## Cities (all coming soon)
- 5 launch cities on the Costa del Sol — announced soon (e-scooters + e-bikes)

## Safety
- Helmet included with every scooter
- One rider per vehicle (tandem detection)
- No riding under the influence (cognitive test at peak hours)
- Park in designated areas only
- Beginner mode available (15 km/h)

## Sustainability
- Zero direct emissions
- Carbon-neutral operations via verified carbon credits
- Swappable and recycled batteries
- Vehicle recycling program at end of life
